name: PEND_CLEAR_BEATS_SET
misconception: Software W1C clear given priority over the hardware expiration set of PEND.

name: OVF_USES_POSTCLEAR_PEND
misconception: OVF set condition looks at PEND after a same-cycle W1C clear instead of the held PEND.

name: RELOAD_USES_WRITTEN_LOAD
misconception: Periodic reload transfer takes the value being written to LOAD in the same cycle (new SHADOW) instead of the held SHADOW.

name: SW_EN_BEATS_ONESHOT_COMPLETION
misconception: A coincident CTRL write of EN wins over the one-shot completion clearing EN.

name: LEVEL_SENSITIVE_START
misconception: Any CTRL write with EN=1 is treated as a start (reload + PCNT clear), even when already enabled.

name: START_KEEPS_PRESCALER_PHASE
misconception: A start reloads COUNT and ACTIVE but does not clear PCNT, so a re-enabled timer resumes its old prescaler phase.

name: PRESCALER_EQUALITY_COMPARE
misconception: Tick uses PCNT == PSC instead of PCNT >= PSC, so lowering PSC below PCNT misses ticks until PCNT wraps.

name: RESTART_REQUIRES_EN
misconception: CMD.RESTART is ignored while the timer is stopped (EN=0).

name: IE_GATES_PEND
misconception: The interrupt-enable mask is applied to the status flag: expirations with IE=0 do not set PEND.

name: IRQ_REGISTERED
misconception: irq is registered (APB-template habit), so it lags PEND & IE by one cycle.
